memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Epilepsy
- Status: Seizure-free on levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
- Plan: Continue current AEDs; advise seizure diary.
Vitamin D deficiency
- Status: Initiated loading cholecalciferol 60000 IU weekly.
- Plan: Check levels after 8 weeks.
Depression
- Status: Low mood, PHQ-9 10; on sertraline 50 mg OD.
- Plan: Continue sertraline; add mirtazapine 15 mg HS if no improvement in 4 weeks.
Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose-lowering therapy).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 14 ng/mL (ref 30‑100).
Serum calcium: 9.1 mg/dL (ref 8.6‑10.3).
Serum phosphate: 2.8 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks (loading).
After loading: cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD ongoing.
Levetiracetam 500 mg BD.
Lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
Sertraline 50 mg OD.
Mirtazapine 15 mg HS.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Epilepsy
- Status: No seizures; medication adherence good.
- Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
Vitamin D deficiency
- Status: 25‑OH vitamin D 28 ng/mL after loading; still insufficient.
- Plan: Switch to cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD and re‑check in 3 months.
Depression
- Status: Mood improved, PHQ-9 6; on sertraline 50 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS.
- Plan: Maintain current antidepressants; monitor for sedation.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum sodium: 138 mmol/L (ref 135‑145).
Serum creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (ref 0.7‑1.3).
TSH: 2.1 µIU/mL (ref 0.4‑4.5).
Vitamin B12: 320 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Sertraline increased to 100 mg OD.
Mirtazapine 15 mg HS unchanged.
Levetiracetam 500 mg BD.
Lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
Cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve felt a bit dizzy in the mornings after starting the higher sertraline dose. It improves after breakfast. No new seizures. Mood feels steadier.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: EEG: Background activity normal; no epileptiform discharges. No changes from prior study.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Neurology, Dr S. Rao (Consultant) for review of epilepsy management and consideration of medication taper given prolonged seizure freedom.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Neurology review: Patient seizure-free for 12 months. Recommend continuing current AEDs; no taper needed at present. Return to routine follow‑up in 6 months.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed from 2026-04-12 10:00 to 2026-04-12 14:30 for follow‑up with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Epilepsy
- Status: Seizure‑free; medication unchanged.
- Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
Vitamin D deficiency
- Status: 25‑OH vitamin D 32 ng/mL on cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD.
- Plan: Continue maintenance dose; re‑check in 6 months.
Depression
- Status: Mood stable, PHQ-9 4; on sertraline 100 mg OD, mirtazapine 15 mg HS.
- Plan: Continue antidepressants; consider sertraline taper if remission persists.
Due: HbA1c not applicable.
